claims.claim: exec block in RuntimeConfig binds a pack tool to a subprocess reading JSON on stdin and writing JSON on stdout
Unmatched tools: key is skipped, logged at WARN with name and registered_tools; the tool keeps its pack-declared mode; other entries apply
WithToolDescriptorOverride treats an unknown name the same way (skip with warning)
Server processes are stopped when the conversation closes
Pack tool schema and prompt tools list shape
One-shot input is {"args": {...}}; output is {"result": ...} or {"error": ...}
runtime: server keeps one process running and speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, one JSON object per line, method execute with params.args
Server response is {jsonrpc,id,result}; error object reports failure
Only the listed env variable names are forwarded; the subprocess does not inherit the full host environment
env values are read from the host at invocation time
On timeout the subprocess is killed and the tool returns an error to the LLM
If timeout_ms is omitted the runtime uses a default timeout
No OnTool registration is required for exec-bound tools; the runtime handles lifecycle
